user.title: Configure FuelWatch HA
user.description: Enter a suburb or postcode and select the fuel type. You can use either location field.

data_description.suburb: Western Australian suburb name (e.g. Secret Harbour, Naval Base).
data_description.postcode: Four-digit WA postcode. Postcode matching depends on postcode data supplied by the source API.
data_description.product: The type of fuel you want to monitor.

station.title: Select Station
station.description: Found {count} stations for {product} near {suburb}. Stations are listed cheapest first with today's price. Both today and tomorrow prices will be tracked.

error.no_stations_found: No stations found for this location and fuel type. Try entering the suburb instead.
error.location_required: Enter either a suburb or a postcode.
